headline: BBVA is first European bank to join Personal Agent Protocol
body: BBVA has become the first European bank to join the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) initiative. The initiative aims to help develop a common protocol that enables secure interactions between AI agents and businesses.
note: For bank operations teams, the open question is whether one shared protocol could let agents from different providers reach a bank's services under common rules.
